title: Preflight groups repeated failures, names the provider and puts the fix beside them
acceptance: Tracks that fail for the same reason and provider show as one group with a count, not one row each.
A no-connected-provider failure names the provider the tracks are linked to.
The fix action (connect or reconnect that provider, or Manage connections) sits with the group, not after the full list.
Run without music and the honest Blocked verdict are unchanged.
